worldcombat.skill.skullbash.summary: Tuck in to raise armour, defence and damage reduction, then charge straight ahead and ram the first foe, hurling it and the user onward; pinning it against a wall hits harder, staggers it and rents a passable gap through the wall behind that closes itself a few seconds later. The user cannot move while bracing and the charge never bends.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.use.1: Trade defence for a heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.use.2: Pin a foe to a wall
After bracing in place, charge %1$s blocks in a straight line, dealing %2$s contact damage on contact.
The tuck lasts %1$s seconds, granting %2$s armour, %3$s damage reduction and %4$s defence stages.
Charges at %1$s blocks/tick with a %2$s block radius, shoving the hit foe %3$s blocks.

If a wall or block sits right behind the target, the ram deals %1$s times the damage, staggers it for %2$s seconds and rents up to %3$s blocks behind it into a passable gap; the gap closes itself after %4$s seconds with the original terrain back.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.stance.quick: Quick tuck: shorter brace, a little less armour, faster recovery, but a weaker ram.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.stance.deep: Deep brace: longer brace, stronger armour and reduction, one more defence stage, longer recovery; the longer standstill buys a heavier ram.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s seconds with a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.growth.0: At level %1$s, the hit shove rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.growth.1: At level %1$s, the tuck raises defence to %2$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.growth.2: At level %1$s, the commit cooldown drops to %2$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.preference.d: On (deep brace): a longer brace with stronger armour and reduction, one more defence stage and a longer charge, but a slower recovery. Off (quick tuck): a shorter, weaker brace that recovers fast.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.preference.a: The companion will not brace below this HP fraction; higher is more cautious, lower lets it ram while wounded.
The companion braces and charges a foe within this distance; smaller keeps it close, larger lets it chase out to intercept.
When on, a companion on hold will leave its post to ram a target that enters the engagement radius.
